name: What is the difference between regular cleaning and biohazard cleanup?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between regular cleaning and biohazard cleanup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Regular cleaning focuses on general tidiness and hygiene, removing visible dirt and dust using common household products. Biohazard cleanup, however, is a specialized process designed to safely remove and disinfect biologically hazardous materials like blood, bodily fluids, and infectious waste. It involves industrial-grade disinfectants, specialized equipment, personal protective gear, and strict protocols to eliminate pathogens, odors, and potential health risks that regular cleaning cannot address, ensuring complete decontamination.
acceptedAnswer.description: Regular cleaning handles visible dirt, while biohazard cleanup specifically removes and disinfects hazardous biological materials, using specialized equipment and protocols to eliminate pathogens and health risks.
